description: NotebookLM Enterprise API manages notebooks via Google Cloud's Discovery Engine REST endpoints; Pre-GA.
auth_notes: Google Cloud access token from gcloud sent in the Authorization header; users sign in via Google or third-party identity provider.
gate_detail: Requires a Google Cloud project with organization identity provider configured and an admin (project owner or Cloud NotebookLM Admin) setting up the product. API is Pre-GA with limited support.
api_scope: REST methods under v1alpha for notebooks, such as retrieving and listing recently viewed notebooks, and adding sources.
mcp_notes: Only third-party notebooklm-mcp tools using browser session cookies appear; no vendor-published MCP server in sources.
blocker_detail: Enterprise setup by a project owner or Cloud NotebookLM Admin with identity provider configured; feature is Pre-GA.

evidence.quote: you must have your organization's identity provider (IdP)
The project owner or a user who has the Cloud NotebookLM Admin role can set up
Pre-GA features are available "as is" and might have limited support.

uncertainties: Pricing or license requirement for the enterprise API is not stated in first-party sources.
Webhooks and sandbox are not mentioned.
Consumer NotebookLM has no first-party public API in the sources.
